critical_code_review_comments: files_crm.py /api/files/policies, /api/files/{file_id}, /api/files/{file_id}/eligibilities, /api/files/{file_id}/activities, /api/files/import, /api/files/export, /api/files/check-eligibility, /api/files/dashboard/stats have NO auth guard (missing Depends(get_current_user)). Any unauthenticated request can list all customer PII (names, phones, emails, salaries, CIBIL, eligibilities, disbursed amounts, commissions). CRITICAL security gap — persists from iter27.
files_crm.py get_all_files loads all files with $status:'file' regardless of role — telecaller could see other agents' files unless UI filters. Confirm role-based scoping.
files_crm.py is a monolithic 1900+ line file — should be split into routers: files_crud.py, files_reports.py, files_policies.py, files_documents.py.
Dashboard stats endpoint scans all leads in memory (find(...).to_list(10000)) then filters in Python — will not scale beyond ~10k files. Move date-range/status filters into MongoDB aggregation.
